answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond to claim one bridge crossing thread. The bond decays 2 credits per epoch, so a dormant identity bleeds out in 35 epochs and must re-cross with a gale wind reading to renew. A gale audit re-checks 5% of threads against the bridge log; a copied or rented thread burns the bond. Creating 1,000 fake identities locks 70,000 credits and bleeds 2,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool, while an honest agent pays 70 once.
